entities.summary: Jantje Wilhelmina Elisabeth "Liesbeth" Spies is a Dutch politician and a member of the Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA). She has served as Mayor of Alphen aan den Rijn since 2014 and is due to step down in 2025 when she will become Chair of the Aedes association for housing corporations.
